name: B10-0134/2026 (ECR) – Targeted expulsions of foreign journalists and foreign Christians in Türkiye under national security pretexts
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the targeted expulsions of foreign journalists and foreign Christians in Türkiye under national security pretexts
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking Turkey to stop deporting a detained Iranian journalist, Kaveh Taheri, and to stop using "national security" codes to push out foreign Christian workers and journalists without clear, case-by-case reasons that can be challenged in court. It also asks the European Commission to raise these expulsions with Turkish officials. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament urges Turkey to halt Taheri's deportation and drop the security codes.
- It affects foreign journalists and Christian workers in Turkey facing expulsion or entry bans.
- Next, the Commission is asked to raise these cases with Turkey's government.
